description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply & Higher Education - Order to acquire the lands in Minigamuwa, Hatharaliyadda D/S Division, Kandy District an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2043/03 of 30.17.2017 for Kandy-Pathadumbara Water Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains a detailed schedule describing specific land parcels (including lot numbers, extent, boundaries, and claimants) for the construction of a water supply project. While it mentions a minister's name and authority, the core content focuses on property acquisition and land descriptions, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
